title: Hell Freezes Over: Randy Makes a Trade, and Philliberto Fleeces Him for It
dek: The league's most famously tight-fisted manager finally opened his wallet before Week 4, sending Javonte Williams to Team Pillbert for Stefon Diggs, and the title odds say the villain just got richer.
body: Mark your calendars, carve it into a stone tablet, alert the league historians: Randy made a trade. The man who treats his roster like a bank vault with a broken combination shipped running back Javonte Williams to Alan's Team Pillbert in exchange for wide receiver Stefon Diggs before Week 4. Somewhere, every manager who ever sent Randy an offer and got back a complaint and a 'no' is staring at the wall wondering what Philly said that they didn't.

The raw numbers are not kind to The fumblers. Williams had put up 45.5 points across three weeks on a roster, while Diggs had 38 over the same stretch, so Randy gave up the more productive player and swapped his RB for a WR in the process. Maybe Randy sees a positional need the rest of us don't, or maybe he's betting on Diggs heating up. Either way, the first trade of his Buckaroo career began with him sending away 7.5 extra points of production.

The title odds tell the story even louder. Team Pillbert jumped from 9% to 20% to win the Buckaroo Bowl, more than doubling its chances in a single transaction. The fumblers slid from 15% to 13%. In other words, the deal turned Alan from a long shot into a legitimate contender while Randy paid two percentage points for the privilege of finally clicking 'accept.'

So who won it on paper? This one isn't close: Phillibert, the league's resident bad guy, walked away with the better player and an 11-point bump in championship equity. It's the classic villain move, finding the one guy in the league who never trades and convincing him that today is the day. Randy now has three-plus months to prove the spreadsheet wrong, and knowing Randy, he'll have plenty to say about it either way.

social.author: Buckaroo Insider
social.text: Sources confirm Randy has made a trade. Repeat: Randy has made a trade. Javonte Williams to Team Pillbert, Stefon Diggs to The fumblers. Investigation into whether Alan used hypnosis is ongoing.

social.author: Team Pillbert Fan Club
social.text: 9% to 20% in one move. The bad guys are BACK and we have a running back. Bow down to Philliberto.

social.author: The Fumble Zone
social.text: First trade in franchise history and we gave up 45.5 points for 38. Love that for us. Diggs, please, we're begging you.

social.author: Spreadsheet Sam
social.text: Odds math on the Randy-Alan deal: Pillbert +11 points, fumblers -2. Total title equity created out of thin air: 9 points, and almost all of it went to the villain.

social.author: Waiver Wire Wendy
social.text: Every manager who's had an offer rejected by Randy is currently drafting a very angry group chat message. Alan really said 'watch this' and did it.
